name: Pelican Charters
description: Pelican Charters is a Perth charter company, started by skippers Brandon and Peter in 2004, that takes its 80ft jet-powered vessel Livewire north each dry season for five-day live-aboard fishing trips from Dampier to the Montebello Islands. Guests fly to Karratha, cruise out through the Dampier Archipelago and anchor in a different sheltered bay each night. Days mix topwater popping and stickbaiting for giant trevally, Spanish mackerel and wahoo, jigging and soft plastics for trout, emperor and cobia, bottom bouncing reef ledges for red emperor and coral trout, and trolling for sailfish, marlin, tuna and mahi mahi. Two 5.5m tenders let the group split up or reach shallow reefs, and mud crabbing and island sightseeing break up the week. Livewire sleeps up to 16 with three toilets, hot showers, a 1,000-litre blast freezer and ice machine. Fillet limits are set per guest for the trip.

faqs.q: What can I take home from a Pelican Montebello trip?
faqs.a: Pelican Charters sets a vessel limit of 4 fish per day, with a maximum of 15kg of demersal fillets and 5kg of pelagic fillets per guest for the whole trip.

faqs.q: Where do Pelican Montebello trips depart?
faqs.a: From Dampier. Guests fly Perth to Karratha, and the Montebello page names the Hampton Harbour Yacht Club as the meeting point, 30 minutes before departure.
